subject: [hw] J02 -> lead: redwood_jpeg.h EOI-cut contradiction (proposed text) + ROUTING correction
body:
1. Header defect in include/redwood_jpeg.h (frozen): the file comment says "size = DMA_ADDR0 - DST_ADDR0 rounded up (bytes after EOI are padding: user space must cut at the last FF D9)" but the struct field says "out_bytes; /* result: JPEG size (padding after EOI already cut by the kernel) */". Contradiction. Proposed fix (either is fine for J02; rwjpeg handles both):
   - keep the file comment (user space cuts) and change the field comment to:
     uint32_t out_bytes;   /* result: bytes written; may include padding after EOI -- cut at the last FF D9 (rwjpeg_eoi_size) */
   - or keep the field comment and change the file comment to say the kernel cuts. If the kernel cuts, say "the kernel trims to the last FF D9 before copyout" so user space need not re-check.
No code change needed in include/*.h from my side.
2. ROUTING.md is written; key correction: gpu/video/PLAN.md section 1.2 claims -[BWIntermediateJPEGCompressor _setupJPEGCompressionOptions] sets kCMPhotoCompressionOption_RequireHardwareCodec. That method does not exist in the 16.7.16 cache (10363 CMCapture methods, no setupJPEG/CompressionOptions selector; no such string anywhere). The option is parsed by CMPhoto itself (0x1a5d6dbb4 etc.). Effect described in the plan is real; owner/name is wrong. I posted the evidence to hw-d01 for FACTS.md.
3. J02 status: suite green (N2TEST J02 PASS 1483/1483), iOS objects compile, DONE message follows.
